main_text.p: animum firmant. fraudes, ac technæ in comminiscendis rebus similibus Photij, cui notæ non sunt? Et ante omnia illud considerandum est, postremam hanc Photianam, nulla cogente necessitate, celebratam fuisse. Nanque antea Basilio intercedente, & Ioanne Pontifice non renuente Photius, multis Ioannem laudibus extollens, nullam de Symboli additione fecit mentionē; Ecclesiæ Romanæ reconciliatus, & tantundem concupita a se Sede recuperata, frustra denuo in Ioannem, & reliquos Romanos, quorum alienatione tot sibi miserrime viventi mala evenere, & ut eos sibi benevolos redderet, tot labores animo semper perturbato, atque incerto insumpserat, eiectus, profugus, tristis, inops, tum postmodum illorum sibi reconciliatorum, nulla id exposcente necessitate, animos denuo exasperasset. Frustra cum quiescimus, turbas quærimus, & cum pace fruimur, hostes ad iracundiam, & potissimum si sunt melioris conditionis, concitamus. Id plane fuisset irritare crabrones. Annon una solutus plaga, stolide novis conatibus obductam sibi ab Ecclesia Romana cicatricem refricasset, ut novum vulnus exciperet? Non sunt contemnenda, quæ in hac Synodo stabiliuntur. page.notes: Page is printed in one column with no marginal text. Ink stains and show-through on the left and right edges are not transcribed. Several words are read with some doubt because of the scan: "mentionē" (macron over e), "viventi", "exposcente". The printed long s has been written as plain s throughout, and the printed spelling "fibi"/"fruftra" has been normalised to sibi/frustra per the long-s rule. Printed u/v spellings ("viuenti", "euenere", "Annon vna", "nouis") have been changed to v/u per the rule. Catchword "Ec-" at the foot right. No running head or signature printed.
